ios.desc:
Plan your day visually. Stay focused. Get things done.

400,000+ five-star ratings · Trusted by 1.5 million active users

The daily planner built for how your brain actually works. Map your tasks and calendar onto a visual timeline, block your time with intention, and finally build a routine that sticks — whether you have ADHD or just a lot on your plate.

WHY STRUCTURED WORKS

Most planners give you a blank page. Structured gives you a timeline. You see your whole day laid out, with every task, event, and routine in order. It's time blocking made simple.

Built for ADHD minds, busy professionals, and students who need more than a to-do list.

FREE FEATURES

- Visual day planner with an intuitive drag-and-drop timeline
- Inbox to capture ideas fast and sort them later
- Syncs across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac
- Break big projects into sub-tasks with notes
- Pomodoro focus timer, Live Activities, and interactive widgets
- Color-coding and hundreds of icons to personalize your schedule
- Accessibility built in: VoiceOver, Voice Control, dyslexia-friendly font, and multiple languages

STRUCTURED PRO

- Connect your calendars and Reminders for a complete daily schedule organizer
- Build recurring tasks and routines
- AI-powered day planning: draft your schedule in seconds
- Replan: automatically reschedules missed or forgotten tasks
- Custom notifications to match your workflow

PERFECT FOR

- ADHD-friendly daily planning that actually sticks
- Time blocking your work and study sessions
- Morning routine and evening routine planning
- Students managing class timetables and study tasks
- Anyone who wants a simple to-do list app with a timeline view
- Habit tracking alongside your daily task planner

YOUR DAY, YOUR WAY

Structured isn't just a task manager or a habit tracker. It's the daily planner that puts everything in one place — so you can plan your day, build better habits, and get things done without the overwhelm.

Structured Pro is available monthly, annually, or as a lifetime purchase.

quotes.text:
For those on ios - check out “Structured”. It’s a nice mix of both.

https://apps.apple.com/app/id1499198946

For me it depends on the day, some days I am super productive, other days it’s impossible for me to focus no matter what. I find that I’m more focused in the early morning before anyone else is up.

A few apps that help keep me on track are: Structured [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/structured-day-planner/id1499198946] - A planner that I cannot recommend enough. and Stoic [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/stoic/id1312926037] a journal app that I mostly use for white noise generation, it allows you to mix sounds perfectly. (The journal part is locked behind a subscription, hence why I don’t use it)
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: How do you stay focused when working at home?
